_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja DreamChamber/Komnata Snow (154 terminy, ~28 mikroscen) - laboratorium Zephyra. Zawiera scene HexBottle 3 z tajemnicza postacia mowiaca archaicznym rejestrem, ktora pomaga wydobyc wspomnienie z Hexa - zidentyfikowana jako Symmetry (archaiczny szekspirowski styl, zaimek 'she', watek pasuje do jej postaci).
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci/rejestru jezykowego (np. archaiczny styl w HexBottle 3 = Symmetry). Do weryfikacji w grze przy watpliwosciach.
_meta.uwagi: Tytuly ksiazek Zephyra (book 1-6) przetlumaczone z zachowaniem gry slownej 'oneirology' (nauka o snach, batch book 2 - Grimoire probuje wymowic trudne slowo).

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.en: Maybe we can get Hex to think about something else...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.pl: Może uda nam się skłonić Hexa, żeby pomyślał o czymś innym...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.en: [i]He is nocturnal, you will leave him be.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.pl: [i]Jest nocnym stworzeniem, zostawicie go w spokoju.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.speaker: Zephyr

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.en: Hex is my friend. I may be of help.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.pl: Hex jest moim przyjacielem. Mogę wam pomóc.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.speaker: Symmetry

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.en: His thoughts and memories are wrought visible upon his skin.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.pl: Jego myśli i wspomnienia stają się widoczne na jego skórze.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.speaker: Symmetry

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.en: Surely, you wish for him to think upon the last time he saw Magnus Mortuga?
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.pl: Z pewnością pragniecie, by przypomniał sobie ostatni raz, gdy widział Magnusa Mortugę?
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.speaker: Symmetry

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.en: What's she doing? She's just tapping the glass-
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.pl: Co ona robi? Po prostu stuka w szkło-
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.en: Never mind that, take a look at this...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.en: We got the Hex Bottle Mortuga Memory.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.pl: Zdobyliśmy Wspomnienie Mortugi z Butelki Hexa.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexBottle.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexIdea/S.en: So Hex actually shows his thoughts on his skin??
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexIdea/S.pl: Więc Hex naprawdę pokazuje swoje myśli na skórze??
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexIdea/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexIdea/S.en: Hey, what if we got him to think about something else??
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexIdea/S.pl: Hej, a co jeśli skłonimy go, żeby pomyślał o czymś innym??
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_HexIdea/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en: [i]I think I can see a face in there.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en: The human habit of seeing faces where there... [i]aren't...[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.pl: Ludzki nawyk dostrzegania twarzy tam, gdzie ich... [i]nie ma...[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en: Ok no, I just saw it too.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.pl: Okej nie, ja też to właśnie zobaczyłem.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en: Maybe there's a switch or something on the other side?
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.pl: Może jest jakiś przełącznik czy coś po drugiej stronie?
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en: Because I absolutely do not want to.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en: This one's not really a book.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.pl: To tak naprawdę nie jest książka.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en: The Caretaker's Journal? We already looked at it.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en: ...what if I wanted to look at it again?
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.pl: ...a co, jeśli chciałbym spojrzeć na niego jeszcze raz?
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en: [i]The Seven Secrets of[/i] oh, on - uh...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en: [i]The Seven Secrets of Oneirology[/i], by Edward Edmonton.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en:
[i]It Is Speaking,
If You Are Listening[/i],
by Carl Cavendish.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.pl:
[i]To Przemawia,
Jeśli Słuchasz,[/i]
autorstwa Carla Cavendisha.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en:
[i]A Ghost Rises Before Me[/i],
by Josef Jenkins.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.pl:
[i]Duch Powstaje Przede Mną,[/i]
autorstwa Josefa Jenkinsa.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en:
[i]The Magician of the Soul[/i],
by Annabelle August.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en: There might be [i]something[/i] we could try...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.en: But - I don't think it's anything to do with the books themselves.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.pl: Ale - nie sądzę, żeby to miało cokolwiek wspólnego z samymi książkami.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ZephyrBoo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bed/Secti.en: I worry if I slept in that thing I'd get transformed into a monster or something.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bed/Secti.pl: Martwię się, że gdybym spała w tym czymś, zmieniłabym się w potwora czy coś.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bed/Secti.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bed/Secti.en: [h]I[/h] worry that sleeping at a fourty-five degree angle would be bad for my back.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bed/Secti.pl: [h]Ja[/h] martwię się, że spanie pod kątem czterdziestu pięciu stopni byłoby złe dla moich pleców.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bed/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bgbooks/S.en: That's what old books smell like.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bgbooks/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bgbooks/S.en: Do you not own any old books??
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bgbooks/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bigjars/S.en:
Big glass bell jars.
With [i]creepy things[/i] inside.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bigjars/S.pl:
Wielkie szklane słoje kloszowe.
Z [i]przerażającymi rzeczami[/i] w środku.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bigjars/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bigjars/S.en: If I had a penny for every time we go somewhere and there's big glass bell jars with creepy things inside...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bigjars/S.pl: Gdybym dostawała grosz za każdym razem, kiedy gdzieś idziemy i są tam wielkie szklane słoje z przerażającymi rzeczami w środku...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bigjars/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_booksbehi.en: These books are kept behind glass...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_booksbehi.pl: Te książki są trzymane za szkłem...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_booksbehi.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_booksbott.en: Let's take a closer look at that bookshelf.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_booksbott.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_booksbott.en: Let's take another look at this bookshelf...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_booksbott.pl: Spójrzmy jeszcze raz na tę biblioteczkę...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_booksbott.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bottlesSt.en: ...I'll meet you in the middle at [h]poisoned perfume.[/h]
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bottlesSt.pl: ...spotkajmy się w połowie drogi na [h]zatrutych perfumach.[/h]
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bottlesSt.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bottlesSt.en: A set of small glass bottles...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_bottlesSt.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_cabinet l.en: The kind of place you'd keep a glass of water. And a book.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_cabinet l.pl: Takie miejsce, gdzie trzymałbyś szklankę wody. I książkę.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_cabinet l.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_cabinet r.en: I'll just take a look in this cabinet...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_cabinet r.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_cabinet r.en: Yeah I don't think there are any spiders.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_cabinet r.pl: No nie sądzę, żeby były tam jakieś pająki.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_cabinet r.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_cabinet r.en: I [h]do[/h] seem to need constant reminding.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_cabinet r.pl: Wygląda na to, że [h]rzeczywiście[/h] muszę być stale przypominana.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_cabinet r.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ceilingdo.en: All the light coming from the top gets filtered through the pink glass...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ceilingdo.pl: Całe światło z góry jest filtrowane przez różowe szkło...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ceilingdo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ceilingdo.en: ...it gives the whole room a really weird vibe.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ceilingdo.pl: ...to nadaje całemu pomieszczeniu naprawdę dziwny klimat.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_ceilingdo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_chainligh.en: I wonder how it gets electricity...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_chainligh.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_chainligh.en: I would recommend that you [h]don't[/h] wonder about that.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_chainligh.pl: Poleciłbym, żebyś [h]nie[/h] zastanawiała się nad tym.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_chainligh.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_floorwire.en: Don't trip on that wire, Sally.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_floorwire.pl: Nie potknij się o ten kabel, Sally.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_floorwire.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_fullscree.en: [i]I think we'd better talk to him before we touch any of his stuff.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_fullscree.pl: [i]Chyba lepiej z nim porozmawiajmy, zanim dotkniemy jego rzeczy.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_fullscree.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_posters/S.pl: Co jest na tych wykresach ściennych?
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_posters/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_scroll ca.en:
The cabinet's full of scrolls.
But, uh...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_scroll ca.pl:
Szafka jest pełna zwojów.
Ale, yy...
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_scroll ca.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_scroll ca.en: Can't think of an excuse not to read them?
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_scroll ca.pl: Nie możesz wymyślić wymówki, żeby ich nie czytać?
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_scroll ca.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_scroll ca.en:
Hell, just say they're blank.
No-one'll know.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_scroll ca.pl:
A niech to, po prostu powiedz, że są puste.
Nikt się nie dowie.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_scroll ca.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_secretdoo.en: My secret door quota is [h]well[/h] on the way to being met.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_secretdoo.pl: Mój limit tajemnych drzwi jest [h]zdecydowanie[/h] bliski wypełnienia.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_secretdoo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_secretdoo.en: The bookcase moved! It was a secret door!
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_secretdoo.pl: Regał się poruszył! To były tajemne drzwi!
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_secretdoo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_shelves/S.en: ...I can't see anything important on these shelves.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_shelves/S.pl: ...nie widzę niczego ważnego na tych półkach.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_shelves/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_shelves/S.en:
Good.
Because I couldn't reach the stuff at the top if I wanted to.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_shelves/S.pl:
Dobrze.
Bo i tak nie sięgnęłabym do rzeczy na górze, nawet gdybym chciała.
Examine/Exam_Area_DreamChamber_shelves/S.speaker: Sally

do_pozniejszej_weryfikacji.issue: Tajemnicza postac pomagajaca wydobyc wspomnienie z Hexa (archaiczny rejestr, zaimek zenski) przypisana jako Symmetry na podstawie stylu jezykowego i plci - brak jakiegokolwiek potwierdzenia w metadata zrodla (kategoria Examine nie ma speaker_map). Do weryfikacji w grze.
